name: symbolic_regression
description: Search for a closed-form expression that fits numeric data (symbolic regression). Use this when the operator wants a formula, a law, or an equation that explains a table of numbers — not to evaluate a known expression (that is calculator) and not for a statistical summary (mean, r). Pass the points in JSON. Returns a Pareto front of {expr, complexity, mse}: simpler expressions first. Caps: 200 rows, 6 input columns. Default operators + - * / neg sin cos.
llm_description: Discover a formula that fits numbers. {x,y} or {rows} (last col y) or {csv}. Returns Pareto {expr,complexity,mse}. Not calculator (eval a known expr).

x.description: Inputs. A list of numbers (one feature) or a list of rows (each row is one sample's features).

rows.description: Each row is [x1, x2, ..., y]. Last column is the target.

csv.description: CSV text, last column is y. No header.

variables.description: Names for x0, x1, ... in the printed expressions.

operators.description: Subset of + - * / neg sin cos exp log. Default + - * / neg sin cos.

seed.description: RNG seed. Same seed, same front.
